p: children of Joseph fell from Jordan: That is, to Ephraim and his children: for Manasseh's portion follows.
thereof are at the sea: Of their inheritance.
took their inheritance: Severally, first Ephraim, and then Manasseh.
and went out at Jordan: For so far the coasts reach.
separate cities for the children of: Because Ephraim's tribe was far greater than Manasseh, therefore he had more cities.
